race.description: Farm Frites MCC Series Heat 5 Hcp (Bm70)
race.comment: Arguably race of the day. COL KLINK (6) is a huge danger. He's off a let-up having won from well back in a Class 1 at Bendigo when last seen, coming from well off the speed. Looks very smart, he'll be the one charging late. SPEX (13) has won two in a row, putting five lengths on a weaker field at Tatura last start. Harder now but have to include. ENDLESS SUMMER (2) chased a good one last start over 1300m at Bendigo and has solid claims. CORONATIONHERCULES (7) is going well lately scoring two wins with one placing from four appearances this preparation including a last-start win at Mornington on soft going. Worth including.
